evidence: Both process crash reports extracted from iPad.xcresult contain the same faulting stack.
cause: ObjC completion inherited MainActor isolation but WebRTC invoked it on its signaling thread.
fix: Explicit @Sendable closures for all peer and camera completions; only Sendable continuation results cross back into actor-isolated methods.
additionalFix: Camera capturer creation deferred until explicit enable passes permission and lifecycle checks.
verificationLimit: The corrected native peer passes the macOS probe with actor checks enabled. The old callback does not reproduce the iPad trap on the local macOS toolchain; the iOS hosted rerun is the regression authority.
